# integration tests skip when Postgres is unreachable

Integration tests that require a Postgres instance are automatically skipped if a connection cannot be established. This ensures unit tests run everywhere while integration tests only run when the compose Postgres is reachable.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_storage.py` — `tests.test_storage._db_available`
- `tests/test_storage.py` — `tests.test_storage.test_migration_creates_catalog_and_fts_column`
